Market today: Nvidia's CEO change is the clear driver, lifting sentiment for tech. Your holdings are mostly 'SELL' status, deep in the red, especially leveraged ETFs like SOXL and SMCI. Margin amplifies these drops.

Your holdings: SMCI (-40.99%), SOXL (-80.83%), and SMH (-27.45%) are your biggest pain points and need attention. The leveraged ETFs are particularly concerning.

Watch: Keep an eye on the semiconductor ETFs (SOXS, TECS) and Nvidia-related names (NVDD) on the scanner for potential short-covering opportunities.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your deeply underwater, leveraged positions and watching for any signs of stabilization or short-covering in the chip sector.
plays: Consider trimming SMCI if it shows any bounce, given the deep loss and negative status.
Evaluate SOXL and other leveraged ETFs for potential trim on any strength, due to decay and deep losses.
Watch NVDD scanner setup (entry 33.03-32.99, stop 31.75) for potential short-covering play if market sentiment holds.
